product.olivetti-m300-04.summary: The 386SX M300 that pairs WD90C11 video with National 87C311 floppy control.
product.olivetti-m300-04.history: The M300-04 was part of Olivetti’s 386SX M300 range. Its service chapter distinguishes it from the equally clocked M300-10 by its video and floppy controller.
product.olivetti-m300-04.architecture: The guide specifies memory fitted on the board. It lists 3–17 MB and 80 ns access, alongside WD90C11 video and National 87C311 floppy control. The installed capacity is retained as a documentary figure.
product.olivetti-m300-04.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records 1.04.
product.olivetti-m300-04.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m300-04.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m300-04.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 33-1.
